commands:
set -euo pipefail
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-gallery-race-venv-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
npm ci
npx playwright install chromium
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts -g "admin place photo gallery exposes moderator tools in responsive media viewer" --repeat-each=10
cd ..
git diff --check

set -euo pipefail
git add frontend/e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Stabilize admin gallery layout assertion'
git push origin HEAD:work/photomap-frontend-deps-20260919
